exposure: Depressive symptoms in the second and third trimesters
Anxiety symptoms in the second and third trimesters
cohort: 2825 women in Alberta, Canada, with singleton pregnancies who delivered in hospital and had available medical data
finding: After adjusting for confounders, only depressive symptoms in the third trimester were independently associated with an increased risk of emergency cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Depressive symptoms in the third trimester increased the risk of emergency cesarean delivery.
